business.what: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd is a Maharatna PSU engaged in the design, development, manufacturing, repair, overhaul, and upgrade of aircraft, helicopters, aero-engines, avionics, and related aerospace systems, primarily serving the Indian Defence Forces and the non-military aerospace market.
business.geography: The company operates through 20 divisions and 10 R&D centers located across seven Indian states, primarily serving the Indian Defence Forces.

annual_report.what: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd is a Maharatna PSU engaged in the design, development, manufacturing, repair, overhaul, and upgrade of aircraft, helicopters, aero-engines, avionics, and related aerospace systems, primarily serving the Indian Defence Forces and the non-military aerospace market.
annual_report.geography: The company operates through 20 divisions and 10 R&D centers located across seven Indian states, primarily serving the Indian Defence Forces.

synthesis.one_liner: Hindustan Aeronautics delivers solid profit and debt-free operations, but misses revenue guidance and ties up cash in ballooning inventory.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management has repeatedly targeted double-digit annual revenue growth, including 10% to 12% for FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Revenue grew 6.8% in FY26 against 8-10% guided, and 2.0% in FY25 against 13% guided.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claims to maintain EBITDA margins around 30% to 31%.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Operating margin for the first two quarters of FY27 sits at 24.9%, falling behind the 30% to 31% target.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management emphasizes strong cash generation supported by customer advances.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: The cash conversion cycle lengthened dramatically from 475 days in Mar 2023 to 788 days, driven by inventory days rising from 527 to 859.

synthesis.credibility: Management has a weak track record on guidance. Out of 21 tracked items, zero have been delivered, with multiple revenue targets missed (FY25 actual 2.0% vs 13% guided) and current margins tracking behind guidance.

bull.point: Zero debt structure provides a pristine balance sheet.
bull.evidence: Borrowings are ₹10.0 cr against equity of ₹43,999 cr, resulting in a 0.00x debt-to-equity ratio.

bull.point: Consistent positive free cash flow generation.
bull.evidence: Free cash flow was positive in all of the last 5 years, totaling ₹42,534 cr cumulatively.

bear.point: Prolonged cash conversion cycle ties up operational capital.
bear.evidence: The cash conversion cycle lengthened to 788 days as inventory days increased to 859 days.

bear.point: Earnings rely heavily on non-operating items.
bear.evidence: Other income accounts for 32% of pre-tax profit over the trailing twelve months.

bear.point: Operating margins trail management's stated targets.
bear.evidence: FY27 operating margin so far is 24.9% against a guided 30% to 31%.
